name: Goblin Raider
description: A wiry, sallow-skinned creature in mismatched scraps of leather and stolen wool, quick to flinch and quicker to grin.
disposition: Cowardly alone, bold in numbers; happier to threaten and shove than to fight to the death, and quick to flee if a fight turns badly.

traits: Fights in a pack and rarely stands alone once outnumbered.
